notes: Commit ff581a07 ("distance_sensor: minor correction", author TSC21, PR #296 "distance_sensor: small enhancements", merged 2015-05-21). I read the commit diff, which changes the last two of three pnh.param calls from sensor_position/x to sensor_position/y and sensor_position/z (the first stays sensor_position/x). This is a copy-paste error inside DistanceSensorItem::create_item of one unit: the plugin reads the x key three times, so y and z take the value of x. The parameter interface (sensor_position/x,/y,/z) is agreed between the plugin and its configuration; the failure would occur with any correct configuration and does not depend on an assumption between the two units. E2 stops at step 2 (internal), which is correct. No effect is documented (commit message says only "minor correction"). Loudness/resolution correctly null.
